Teaching Assistant
evelyn.harper@email.com · 555-0198-337 · LinkedIn.com/in/evelynharper · Springfield, IL
SUMMARY

Motivated Teaching Assistant adept at supporting professors and students in undergraduate education. Experienced in grading assignments, facilitating discussion groups, and developing supplemental learning materials that boosted student comprehension by 20%. Passionate about fostering an engaging and inclusive classroom environment.
EXPERIENCE
Teaching Assistant — Westlake University - Department of Psychology
Aug 2023 – May 2024
• Supported 2 professors in instruction for Introduction to Psychology courses with 120+ students, leading weekly review sessions that improved midterm exam scores by 12%.
• Graded weekly assignments and exams for 4 course sections, ensuring prompt and accurate feedback, decreasing turnaround time by 25%.
• Coordinated peer study groups and facilitated discussion forums that increased student participation rates by 18%.
• Assisted in developing supplemental materials including quizzes and lecture summaries adopted by department for future course use.
Student Tutor — Westlake University Learning Center
Sep 2022 – Jul 2023
• Provided one-on-one tutoring for 30+ students in Psychology and Sociology courses, resulting in 85% of tutored students improving their grades by at least one letter.
• Created tailored study plans and practice exercises, improving student retention of core concepts by 22% based on pre- and post-session assessments.
• Collaborated with faculty to identify common student challenges and propose new academic workshop topics adopted for fall semester.
